import sys
import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import OrderedDict

MAIN = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"


def q(tag):
    return "{%s}%s" % (MAIN, tag)


path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

rows = []
for row in root.iter(q("row")):
    cells = {}
    for c in row.findall(q("c")):
        ref = c.get("r")
        v = c.find(q("v"))
        col = re.match(r"[A-Za-z]+", ref).group(0) if ref else None
        t = c.get("t")
        if t == "s" and v is not None:
            pass  # strings handled via separate shared-strings lookup below
        cells[col] = v.text if v is not None else None
    rows.append(cells)

# Expense rows 11-22: category in col A, amount in col C
cat_map = OrderedDict()
for cells in rows:
    cat = cells.get("A")
    amt = cells.get("C")
    if cat and amt is not None:
        try:
            val = float(amt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        cat_map.setdefault(cat, 0.0)
        cat_map[cat] += val

grand = 0.0
for cat, sub in cat_map.items():
    print("%-15s %8.2f" % (cat, sub))
    grand += sub
print("TOTAL EXPENSES: %.2f" % grand)
